posts.cooked:
Two problem that i can see in your script are:

  1. when you are executing run.sh the output/error of that file is also getting printed. But in the question it is asked only to print “SUCCESS” or “FAIL”.

    You should redirect the output of run.sh to /dev/null. Apart from this the logic seems correct to me.

  2. In the question it’s mentioned that the file may not have execute permissions. You have not handeled that case as well.
